Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 17
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that Raymond Cannon died in 1951, despite the WebSurfer’s sources indicating he died on June 7, 1977. This misreading led to the wrong conclusion that Why Leave Home? had the director who died first, instead of A Dream Or Two Ago (James Kirkwood Sr., died 1963).
